summary: Today’s tape looks broadly risk-on for crypto, with recent analyst commentary still leaning bullish on BTC, ETH, SOL, XRP, and select altcoins, while gold and Brent remain firm and macro liquidity narratives are supporting both crypto and commodities. The freshest source material available here is mostly from the last few days rather than same-day posts, so several entries reflect the latest visible sentiment rather than strictly intraday updates.

signals.reason: He frames Bitcoin as rejecting the $81K resistance area, says it looks like it is rejecting at an extremely key level, and warns that if the downside condition plays out Bitcoin goes lower today.
